typeProperties.script:
parameters{
	OLEDBDestination_outputfilename as string ()
}

source(output(
		Bank as string,
		CCY as string,
		StatementDate as string,
		LedgerBalance as string,
		LedgerDebitOrCredit as string,
		StatementBalance as string,
		StatementDebitOrCredit as string
	),
	allowSchemaDrift: true,
	validateSchema: false) ~> FlatFileSource
FlatFileSource derive(Bank = trim(Bank),
		LedgerBalance = iif(LedgerDebitOrCredit == 'C', '-' + LedgerBalance, LedgerBalance),
		CCY = trim(CCY),
		StatementBalance = iif(StatementDebitOrCredit == 'D', '-' + StatementBalance, StatementBalance)) ~> ConditionData
ConditionData sink(input(
		Bank as string,
		LedgerBalance as integer,
		CCY as string,
		StatementDate as date 'dd-MM-yyyy',
		StatementBalance as integer
	),
	allowSchemaDrift: true,
	validateSchema: false,errorHandlingOption: 'allErrors',reportSuccessOnError: true,
	saveOrder: 10000,
	mapColumn(
		Bank,
		LedgerBalance,
		CCY,
		StatementDate,
		StatementBalance),
	partitionFileNames:[($OLEDBDestination_outputfilename)],
	partitionBy('hash', 1)) ~> OLEDBDestination
